stem: A team is documenting DynamoDB throughput unit definitions for a payment ledger that mixes read and write operations. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: One RCU supports one write per second for an item up to 4 KB.
One RCU supports one strongly consistent read per second for an item up to 4 KB.
In pay-per-request mode, one request unit is always one 8 KB transactional write.
One WCU supports one strongly consistent read per second for an item up to 1 KB.
One WCU supports one write per second for an item up to 1 KB.

rationale: The defined units are 1 RCU for a 4 KB strongly consistent read per second and 1 WCU for a 1 KB write per second. The alternatives that swap read/write meanings are incorrect. On-demand billing is not represented by a single fixed 8 KB transactional-write definition.
